reasoning.consumed_operand: coverage_rows is validated as the exact complete per-owner candidate patch partition, then each segment is checked in its declared physical class. It constrains which separately pinned native patch may accompany this evidence body. Therefore the exact canonical request-dependent rows are not ignored metadata or an arbitrary success label.
reasoning.single_class_nuance: All8 targets already admit only mapped_land_support. classAllowed for land reuses allowedRows, so the per-cell class geometry predicate adds no positive information or stronger geometric acceptance for this cohort. The new semantic constraint is evidence-to-request pointset/class custody; it is not a new source vintage, classifier or scientific method.
reasoning.identity: Existing v1 hashes target ID plus exact encoded evidence SHA. Binding an exact new disjoint cohort into an already-consumed optional field legitimately changes that existing custody identity without renaming accepted IDs. This is not a general claim that distinct hashes establish contributions or that equivalent encodings get one semantic identity.
reasoning.anti_salt_boundary: The proposal fixes one deterministic maximal-run per-owner derivation from the actual request, preserves every original operand byte after field removal, and permits no ignored keys/locator churn/whitespace or arbitrary row segmentation to obtain IDs. The accepted parser alone does not enforce maximal-run canonicality; this narrower proposal invariant was independently checked, not attributed to a new policy or validator.
reasoning.selection_boundary: All old11770 selected cells/8 original rows remain untouched. Static zero overlap with full accepted71339 and proposed82961 was independently checked. Ordinary stock composer strict all-owner overlap refusal, current selected-base owner-zero and complete retained-reader/integration checks remain mandatory; new IDs alone confer no authority.
